definitions.gloss: board of education (short for {教育委員会|きょういくいいんかい})
definitions.explanation: The short form of {教育委員会|きょういくいいんかい}, the local board that runs public schools in a Japanese prefecture or municipality. Common in news headlines and articles.

examples.japanese: {県教委|けんきょうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The prefectural board of education made an announcement.

examples.japanese: {市教委|しきょうい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The city board of education began an investigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦いじめ→いじめ：09092_ijime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧、{教委|きょうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The board of education was criticized for responding slowly to the bullying problem.

notes:
Usually attached to the level of government: {県教委|けんきょうい} (prefectural), {市教委|しきょうい} (city), {都教委|ときょうい} (Tokyo). In speech the full {教育委員会|きょういくいいんかい} is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教委|きょうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: the board of education announces
- {教委|きょうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: an investigation by the board of education

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{脅威|きょうい}→脅威：13932_kyoui⟧ "threat" and ⟦{驚異|きょうい}→驚異：14657_kyoui⟧ "wonder" have the same reading; in a news story about schools, きょうい is often this word.
